hints.basic: Manage your account, security and interface language.
hints.automation: Configure list loading, search and tag filter behavior.
hints.data: Manage snapshot retention, imports, exports and backups.
hints.site: Configure the site name, branding and registration policy.
hints.theme: Choose the interface theme and page layout, then adjust colors and tag icons.
hints.layouts: Turn on extra bookmark views, tag layouts and tab group layouts. They appear in the switcher menu of the corresponding page.
hints.motion: Turn motion and backgrounds on or off and expand their settings. Ocean preferences can be saved per browser or account.
hints.enhancements: Turn a feature on and expand its settings to adjust tag heat, URL masking and bookmark hover cards.
hints.ai: Turn the assistant and its tools on or off, and expand Model providers to configure AI services.
hints.api: Manage API keys and access permissions for external assistants.
hints.connections: Configure external MCP connections, image storage and the browser extension.
hints.statistics: Turn on to see visit trends, heatmaps and usage analytics. Turning it off keeps historical records.
hints.plugins: Install and manage third-party plugins. Built-in features now live in the settings sections.

popup.title: Popup Permission
popup.description: Allow MarkVault to open popups to use the "Open All Tabs" feature.

howTo.title: How to allow popups?
howTo.step1: On the tab group detail page, click the "Restore All" button
howTo.step2: A popup blocked icon will appear in the browser address bar (usually on the right)
howTo.step3: Click the icon and select "Always allow popups from [site]"
howTo.step4: Refresh the page and click "Restore All" again to use normally

chrome.title: Chrome / Edge
chrome.description: A 🚫 icon will appear on the right side of the address bar. Click it and select "Always allow pop-ups and redirects"

firefox.title: Firefox
firefox.description: A popup blocked notification will appear on the left side of the address bar. Click "Options" → "Allow pop-ups for [site]"

safari.title: Safari
safari.description: Menu bar: Safari → Settings → Websites → Pop-up Windows → Find current site → Select "Allow"

why.title: 💡 Why is popup permission needed?
why.description: The "Open All Tabs" feature needs to open multiple web pages simultaneously. Browsers block batch popups by default for security. After allowing MarkVault popup permission, you can open all pages in a tab group at once, greatly improving efficiency.

install.title: Installation Steps
install.description: Follow these steps to install the browser extension
install.step1Desc: Click the download button above to get the extension file for your browser
install.step2Desc: Extract the downloaded zip file to any folder (preferably a permanent location)
install.step4Desc: In the extension management page, turn on "Developer mode" switch in the top right
install.step5Desc: Click "Load unpacked" and select the extracted folder
install.step6Desc: Extension icon will appear in browser toolbar, click to use

faq.title: FAQ
faq.iconNotFound: Q: Can't find the extension icon after installation?
faq.iconNotFoundAnswer: A: Click the puzzle icon on the right side of browser toolbar, find MarkVault extension and click the pin button to show it in toolbar.
faq.howToGetApiKey: Q: How to get API Key?
faq.howToGetApiKeyAnswer: A: Create a new API Key in the "API" tab of General Settings and copy it to the extension configuration.
faq.supportedBrowsersAnswer: A: Only the Chrome/Chromium version is provided. It works on Chromium-based browsers like Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, 360, QQ and Sogou.
faq.whereToView: Where to view saved tab groups?
faq.whereToViewAnswer: View and manage all saved tab groups on the "Tab Groups" page of MarkVault website.

infoBox.title: Usage Tips
infoBox.tip1: First-time use requires configuring MarkVault website URL and API Key in the extension
infoBox.tip2: Recommended to pin the extension icon to toolbar for quick access
infoBox.tip3: Extension automatically saves tab titles, URLs, and favicons
infoBox.tip4: Saved data syncs to your configured MarkVault instance and can be accessed on multiple devices with the same account
